title: 第1105章 下月初六第1104章 离开万狐山
slug: 修真废柴我的系统有点猛
lines: 涂山烈身体猛地一颤，在涂山云亭那如山似岳的威压和无可辩驳的事实面前，最后一丝顽固被彻底击溃。
他脸色变幻数次，最终化作一声长长的、带着无尽复杂意味的叹息，
朝着姚德龙和雪姒疏的方向，极其艰难却无比郑重地躬身行礼：
“涂山烈……恭贺圣女与姑爷……修成连理！谢……谢姑爷救族之恩！”
最后几个字，几乎是从牙缝里挤出来，却也代表着他保守派立场的彻底瓦解屈服。
墨玦看着这戏剧性的一幕，心情大好，朗声笑道：
“哈哈！今日双喜临门！暗魂已除，隐患尽消！此乃天大喜事！姒疏，德龙，你们的婚事，拖得够久了！”
他直接拍板，声音响彻全场：“本座即刻昭告妖域万族！下月初六！青丘圣地！
为吾女雪姒疏与吾婿姚德龙，举办旷世大婚！我天狐一族，当举族同庆！”
“哈哈哈！好啊！好啊！”墨玦圣主洪亮的笑声还在禁地入口回荡，
那份宣布婚期的豪迈劲头感染着在场每一位天狐族人，
长老们脸上的震惊尚未完全褪去，便又被这喜庆冲淡了几分。
就在这气氛热烈之际——
嗡！
空间仿佛水波般轻轻荡漾，没有惊天动地的威压，却让所有喧嚣瞬间沉寂下来。
一道身影，无声无息地出现在众人前方。
来人一袭纤尘不染的白袍，身姿颀长，气质超然出尘，面容俊朗近乎完美，
眉眼间流淌着一种洞悉万物、却又温和疏离的奇异神韵。
他站在那里，仿佛与天地融为一体，又仿佛独立于时光长河之外。
“拜见折颜老祖！”
“拜见始祖！”
涂山一脉的长老和弟子们，无论是保守派还是革新派，
脸上瞬间涌上发自内心的虔诚与敬畏，齐刷刷躬身行礼，声浪如潮！
即便是涂山云亭与墨玦这两位圣主，也收敛了笑容，神色肃然，微微颔首致意。
“哈哈哈！”墨玦率先打破寂静，笑声中带着亲近与感慨，
“折颜，什么风把你这个千年宅在‘因果天池’的老家伙给吹出来了？你这鼻子够灵的，我们这边刚完事你就到了！”
来者正是天狐族定海神针之一，以因果、灵觉、幻梦三道踏入妖帝领域的无上存在——折颜妖帝！
折颜目光温和地扫过全场，那深邃的眼眸仿佛能看穿人心，最终落在了被众人簇拥的姚德龙身上。
当他的视线触及姚德龙时，那如同古井无波的眼神深处，掠过一丝难以察觉的涟漪，那是纯粹的惊叹。
“如此大事，岂能不来？”折颜的声音清朗平和，如同山涧清泉，却又带着一种安抚人心的力量。
“德龙小友，此番壮举，功在千秋！”
他竟对着姚德龙，这位人族后辈，郑重其事地微微躬身一拜！
这一拜，重若山岳！
整个禁地入口再次陷入一片死寂！连呼吸都仿佛停滞了！妖帝折颜是何等身份？
那是与天同寿、俯瞰万古的绝巅存在！此刻他竟然对一个修炼不过数十载的人族青年躬身行礼？！
“我天狐一族，承蒙始祖遗泽，守护封印数万载，历代先祖前仆后继，魂归此地，只为镇压那混沌莽暗魂本源。”
content_en:
Tu Shanlie's body trembled violently, and in the face of Tu Shan Yunting's mountainous pressure and irrefutable facts, his last trace of stubbornness was completely defeated.
His expression changed several times, and finally turned into a long sigh with endless complex meaning.
Facing the direction of Yao Delong and Xue Sishu, he bowed with great difficulty but solemnity:
"Tu Shanlie...congratulations to the saint and my uncle...for getting married! Thank you...for your kindness in saving the family!"
The last few words were almost squeezed out from between his teeth, but they also represented the complete collapse and surrender of his conservative stance.
Looking at this dramatic scene, Mo Jue was in a good mood and laughed loudly:
"Haha! Double happiness comes to our door today! The dark soul has been eliminated and all hidden dangers have been eliminated! This is a great event! Sishu, Delong, your marriage has been delayed for long enough!"
He made the decision directly, and his voice resounded throughout the audience: "I will tell all the people in the Demon Realm immediately! The sixth day of next month! Qingqiu Holy Land!
We are hosting a unique wedding for my daughter Xuesi Shu and my son-in-law Yao Delong! Our Tianhu clan should celebrate together as a whole! "
"Hahaha! Okay! Okay!" Holy Lord Mo Jue's loud laughter still echoed at the entrance to the forbidden land,
The heroic spirit of announcing the wedding date infected every Tianhu clan member present.
The shock on the elders' faces had not completely faded away, but it was somewhat diluted by the joy.
Just when the atmosphere was warm——
Buzz!
The space rippled gently like water waves. There was no earth-shattering pressure, but all the noise was instantly silenced.
A figure appeared in front of everyone silently.
The visitor was dressed in a spotless white robe, with a tall figure, an aloof temperament, and an almost perfect face.
There is a strange charm that is insightful of all things, yet gentle and distant.
He stood there, as if he was integrated with the heaven and earth, and as if he was independent from the long river of time.
"Greetings to Ancestor Zheyan!"
"Meet the ancestor!"
The elders and disciples of the Tushan lineage, whether they are conservatives or reformists,
Piety and awe from the heart suddenly surged onto their faces, and they all bowed and saluted, making waves!
Even the two Holy Masters, Tushan Yunting and Mo Jue, suppressed their smiles, looked solemn, and nodded slightly in greeting.
"Hahaha!" Mo Jue was the first to break the silence, his laughter filled with intimacy and emotion,
"Zheyan, what brought you, an old guy who has lived in the Cause and Effect Tianchi for thousands of years, out of here? You have a very good nose. You arrived just after we finished our work here!"
The person who came was none other than one of the Heavenly Fox Tribe’s Sea-Dinging Divine Needles, a supreme being who entered the Demon Emperor’s realm through the three paths of cause and effect, spiritual awareness, and fantasy—Zheyan Demon Emperor!
Zheyan's gaze gently swept across the audience, his deep eyes seemed to be able to see through people's hearts, and finally landed on Yao Delong, who was surrounded by everyone.
When his eyes touched Yao Delong, an imperceptible ripple passed through the depths of his eyes, which were as smooth as an ancient well. It was pure wonder.
"How could we not come for such a big event?" Zheyan's voice was clear and peaceful, like a clear spring in a mountain stream, but it also had a power to soothe people's hearts.
"Little friend Delong, this feat is worth a thousand years of work!"
He actually bowed slightly and solemnly to Yao Delong, a descendant of the human race!
This bow is as heavy as a mountain!
The entire entrance to the forbidden area fell into dead silence again! Even breathing seems to have stopped! What is the identity of Demon Emperor Zheyan?
That is the pinnacle existence that lives the same life as heaven and overlooks the eternity! At this moment, he actually bowed to a young human race who had only been practicing for decades? !
"My Tianhu clan has inherited the legacy of our ancestors and guarded the seal for tens of thousands of years. The ancestors of the past generations have succeeded each other, and their souls have returned here, just to suppress the origin of the chaotic dark soul."
